notes: Insights last for one run. After each battle room the player picks 1 of 3. Effect types are listed in packages/sim/src/effects.ts.

insights.name: Ripple Counter
insights.text: Great Counters also hit every enemy near you.

insights.name: Iron Skin
insights.text: Blocks bounce the hit back at the enemy, with a little extra.

insights.name: Wind Step
insights.text: Every 7 combo hits gives a 3-second burst of speed, and you swing faster too!

insights.name: Press the Advantage
insights.text: Enemies that are dizzy, winded or just swung take 30% more damage.

insights.name: Shield Breaker
insights.text: Any hit breaks shields, and breaking one gives you a little Focus.

insights.name: Rally
insights.text: Hang in there! Focus fills 75% faster when your health is below half.
